clues: I am an item you can neither craft nor get from a mob.
You only find me in chests deep down in the darkness, where you'd better stay quiet.
Eight of me around a compass make a compass that points to where you last died.
I come from the Ancient City.
You can't craft me.
A resident of woodland mansions always drops me when it dies – it also shows up in raids.
Hold me in your hand and I save you from death exactly once.
I am golden, have a face and crumble after I have saved you.
I lie in a buried chest – you usually find it with a treasure map.
I am blue and pulse like a heart.
Surrounded by eight nautilus shells I become a source of underwater power.
My name sounds like the center of the ocean.
You can't craft me, and no mob drops me.
You find me in an item frame aboard a ship that never sails.
Phantom membrane repairs me at an anvil.
With firework rockets I become your engine in the air.
You can't craft me.
Only a single mob can drop me – it lives underwater.
Throw me at an enemy during a thunderstorm with the right enchantment, and lightning strikes.
I am a throwing weapon with three prongs.
I need five glass, three obsidian and something only a three-headed boss drops.
I unfold my power on a pyramid of mineral blocks.
I give nearby players effects like Haste or Strength.
I send a beam of light into the sky.
I am made of six crying obsidian and three glowstone blocks.
I am charged with glowstone.
In the Overworld I explode when you try to use me.
In the Nether I set your respawn point.
I am made of exactly three parts: two copper ingots and an amethyst shard.
I am neither weapon nor armor, but I still belong in your hand.
With me you see faraway things magnified.
I point neither north nor to the spawn.
To make me you need a compass and eight shards from the deep.
I show you where you last died.
To make me you need a heavy core and a breeze rod.
You only get the heavy core from an ominous vault in the Trial Chambers.
The deeper you fall before you strike, the more damage I deal.
I am a heavy melee weapon.
I come in sixteen colors and undyed.
When you break me, I keep everything inside me.
To make me you need a chest and two shells from creatures of the End cities.
You can't craft me.
You catch me with an empty glass bottle from a purple cloud.
I turn splash potions into lingering potions.
I come from the mouth of the biggest boss in the End.
I am made of four scraps and four gold ingots.
The scraps are smelted from ancient debris.
With a smithing template I upgrade diamond gear.
Items made of me don't burn in lava.
I am made of blaze powder and an ender pearl.
Throw me and I fly towards an underground stronghold.
Sometimes I break after the throw.
Twelve of me activate the End portal.
A single breeze rod makes four of me.
A mob from the Trial Chambers shoots me around.
Throw me at the ground and I launch you into the air.
I am blind, but I feel every vibration and I can smell you.
I appear when a sculk shrieker has been triggered too often.
I cause Darkness and shoot a sonic boom even through walls.
I live in the Deep Dark.
I am blue, I fly and I have small wings.
Give me an item and I collect all matching ones for you.
I bring items to a note block I heard playing.
You free me from cages at pillager outposts.
I hatch from an egg found in suspicious sand in ocean ruins.
I am an ancient animal with a long nose.
I dig up ancient seeds: torchflower and pitcher plant.
I live in woodland mansions and show up in raids.
I make fangs snap up from the ground.
I summon vexes.
When I die, I always drop a totem.
Three of us guard every ocean monument.
I give you Mining Fatigue so you can't break anything.
When I die, I drop a wet sponge.
I am grey, spiky and much bigger than my smaller relatives.
I come to visit with two llamas.
At night I drink a potion of invisibility.
I sell plants, blocks and dyes for emeralds.
After a while I disappear again.
I drop from a boss that players have to create themselves.
Explosions can't harm me.
There is no beacon without me.
I am created from soul sand and three skulls.
I have three heads.
My skulls cause an effect that turns your hearts black.
When I die, I drop a Nether Star.
Crystals on tall pillars heal me.
When I am defeated, a portal and an egg appear.
I live on an island in the void.
I am made from a block of copper and a carved pumpkin.
I carry items from copper chests into other chests.
Over time I oxidize like copper blocks.
I live underwater in lush caves.
When I get hurt, I play dead.
You breed me with a bucket of tropical fish.
I come in pink, brown, gold, cyan – and very rarely blue.
An elder guardian drops me wet.
In a furnace I dry out again.
I soak up the water around me.
